# requirements-gemma4.txt — pinned deps for gemma-4-31B-it pods (training + eval)
#
# Source of truth for all RunPod/gemma-4 setup. Used by setup-runpod-gemma4.sh.
# DO NOT edit transformers/tokenizers/huggingface_hub versions here without
# testing on a torch>=2.5 pod; gemma-4 requires the specific combination below.
#
# torch is NOT listed here — it comes from the pod base image (torch 2.5.1+cu124)
# via --system-site-packages in the venv. Installing torch from PyPI would pull
# the CPU build. On a fresh pod, always choose a torch>=2.5 base image.
#
# Key constraint: transformers>=5.0 requires torch>=2.5 (device_mesh / infer_schema).
# The runpod/pytorch:2.4 base image is TOO OLD for gemma-4.
# See docs/gemma4-31b-pod-setup.md for the full story.

# --- training / LoRA ---
